summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K on July 24, 2026, reporting a routine PDMR transaction notification. President, US Maya Martinez-Davis acquired 9.407 notional ADSs at $50.76 per ADS within her Executive Supplemental Savings Plan account on July 22, 2026. This is a standard shareholding disclosure under UK market rules, filed as a foreign private issuer report under the 1934 Act. There are no special-situation elements: no merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The transaction is a routine personal investment by a PDMR, not a corporate event.
